dishes.name: Pithiviers
dishes.desc: An almond cake from the Loiret town of Pithiviers, sold glazed or as a puff pastry version close to a galette des rois. One of the emblems of the Loiret.

dishes.name: Andouille de Jargeau
dishes.desc: A chitterling sausage of pork tripe and minced meat in natural casing, traditionally served with mashed potatoes. Made in Jargeau on the Loire for centuries.

dishes.name: Cendré d'Olivet
dishes.desc: A cow's milk cheese like a camembert, coated in ash that once kept flies off. A Loiret farm cheese, now made at Châteauneuf-sur-Loire.

dishes.name: Montargis pralines
dishes.desc: Caramelised, grilled almonds made from an old local recipe. A confectioner in Montargis has been making them since 1903.

dishes.name: Cotignac d'Orléans
dishes.desc: A thick, creamy quince jelly made around Orléans since the late Middle Ages. It is sold in a small spruce box whose lid doubles as a spoon.
